correctness.rationale: All assumptions/quantifiers are explicit. Symmetric rank-factorization gives nonzero principal order-five determinants iff complementary bases of a rank-two dual matroid; nonzero three-minors force every cocircuit to have at least four elements. The thirteen allowed partitions exhaust t=5,6,7; each is realized by an independently checked exact integer matrix. All thirteen witnesses and every relevant 5-minor were recomputed from actual bundled files. No finite verification is used as the universal upper-bound proof.

originality.rationale: The resulting complete thirteen-pattern/eleven-value rank-five seven-coordinate scaling locus is neither the general principal-A-determinant factorization of the 2024 source nor its tabulated rank-three minimum-ML-degree scaling. Oldekop 2026 publicly states results through six coordinates, while a full-text comparison remains inaccessible and is explicitly a residual risk. Searches of mathematical formulations and published results found no stronger precise statement.
residual_risks: The primary 2026 preprint full text was inaccessible; an uninspected proposition or table could in principle already cover the rank-five seven-coordinate count spectrum.

Older rank-two matroid basis-count formulations may establish the combinatorial upper inclusion; the corresponding exact zero-diagonal symmetric realizations and toric factor-count interpretation were not found.
Independent originality adjudication and independent validation have not been performed.
